decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-750abcd0623c]. It says the code now uses errors.Join "for debuggable" and points to PR #22235. It doesn't say which component or error paths are affected, so the subject is unknown. It also doesn't say whether error messages or behaviour change in a way operators can see, so the change and consequence are unknown, and nothing in it tells us which environments are exposed. Deciding this needs the PR or a release-note description that names the affected component and what changes in error output.
